label: (c)
heading: Applicability
text: This AD applies to The Boeing Company Model 757-200 and -300 series airplanes, certificated in any category, equipped with passenger service unit (PSU)-mounted video monitors.

label: (f)
heading: Compliance
text: Comply with this AD within the compliance times specified, unless already done.

label: (g)(1)
heading: Required Actions
text: (1) For airplanes identified in Boeing Special Attention Requirements Bulletin 757-25-0320 RB, Revision 1, dated August 6, 2025: Except as specified by paragraph (h) of this AD, at the applicable times specified in the “Compliance” paragraph of Boeing Special Attention Requirements Bulletin 757-25-0320 RB, Revision 1, dated August 6, 2025, do all applicable actions identified in, and in accordance with, the Accomplishment Instructions of Boeing Special Attention Requirements Bulletin 757-25-0320 RB, Revision 1, dated August 6, 2025.

label: (g)(3)
heading: Required Actions
text: (3) For airplanes not identified in paragraph (g)(1) or (2) of this AD: Within 60 months after the effective date of this AD, replace all PSU-mounted video monitors that do not have secondary retention lanyards with PSU-mounted video monitors that have secondary retention lanyards, using a method approved in accordance with the procedures specified in paragraph (j) of this AD.

label: (c)
heading: Applicability
text: This AD applies to Airbus SAS Model A330-941 airplanes, certificated in any category, as identified in European Union Aviation Safety Agency (EASA) AD 2025-0208, dated September 24, 2025 (EASA AD 2025-0208).

label: (f)
heading: Compliance
text: Comply with this AD within the compliance times specified, unless already done.

label: (g)
heading: Requirements
text: Except as specified in paragraph (h) of this AD: Comply with all required actions and compliance times specified in, and in accordance with, EASA AD 2025-0208.

label: (c)
heading: Applicability
text: This AD applies to Bombardier, Inc., Model BD-100-1A10 airplanes, certificated in any category, serial numbers 20003 through 20407 inclusive, equipped with FMC-5000 flight management computers.

label: (f)
heading: Compliance
text: Comply with this AD within the compliance times specified, unless already done.

label: (g)
heading: Revision of the Airplane Flight Manual (AFM)
text: Within 60 days after the effective date of this AD: Revise the existing AFM and applicable corresponding operational procedures to incorporate the information specified in the Flight Management System (FMS) limitation in Section 02-04—Systems Limitations, of Chapter 02—Limitations, of the applicable AFM, specified in figure 1 to paragraph (g) of this AD.
